data.text: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty expanse.
data.titulo: Let Everything That Has Breath Praise the LORD

data.text: Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his surpassing greatness.
Praise him with the sound of the horn; praise him with harp and lyre.
Praise him with tambourine and dancing; praise him with strings and pipe.
Praise him with sounding cymbals; praise him with loud, ringing cymbals.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
